client_only_extensions.note: Lazy captured streamed creation sharing the same single cursor/checkpoints. Explicit stream:false rejects locally; canonical session.created establishes identity.
Opt-in application callbacks and private error metadata; never serialized as tools or wire request fields.
Local request policy/readiness controls on unchanged canonical operations. Authentication cannot enable retries.

dart_policies: Deep detached typed request/options and handler registration capture.
Dart creation helper forces stream for null/true and rejects explicit false; raw APIs stay manual.
Full-run registered call dedup with explicit 1024-call default budget; overflow fails, never evicts/reruns.
Generic transport retries disabled for logical results; only exact pending-call400 race permits initial+3 attempts at100/300/600ms with stable result key/body.
Private callback observer details and run exceptions preserve explicit causes but never default-print secrets.
A single cursor supports after-yield dispatch; Stream cancellation before resumption never executes that pending call.
